text:
sam: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — want a compact ownership + timeline thread for the rollout/canary gaps. recurring theme: manual revert, missing controller wiring, permissive default percents.

sam: Incident recap: canary at 7% without auto_rollback=true. monitor alert fired but flag-controller had no subscription. ops did manual revert, which is slow. Need durable automation + smaller default blast radius + deploy-time checks.

ivy: I'll take the controller subscription + rule-evaluator. plan: controller subscribes to alert-stream and evaluates rollback_rules; when triggered it flips the flag, records incident id, snapshot, and emits an audit event. aiming POC in 4 business days.

noor: I'll own default blast-radius policy + docs. proposal: new flags default to 0.5% with staggered ramp (0.5 -> 2 -> 5) and per-service caps. drafting RFC and a per-service cap table. target RFC by EOD Fri. :spiral_notepad:

ben: I'll add a deploy-bot preflight that rejects rollout>1% unless auto_rollback=true or a signed two-owner override is present. will land a staging patch tonight. deploy-bot: recorded deploy job=ci/8892 rollout=7 auto_rollback=false -> flagged.

sam: Also recommend a "quarantine" mitigation: instead of immediate rollback, controller can route traffic to a degraded pool for N minutes and run a short smoke suite; if smoke fails then full rollback. add to RFC.

ivy: sample rollback_rules pseudo-schema:

```
rollback_rules:
  - id: p99_latency
    metric: service.p99_ms
    cond: ">= 240"
    window: 3m
    action: rollback
  - id: error_rate
    metric: service.error_rate
    cond: ">= 0.02"
    window: 5m
    action: rollback
```

noor: I'll include mitigation matrix in RFC: flag-type -> default percent -> quarantine allowed? -> owners. Example: user-facing=0.5% default + quarantine enabled; infra=5% default.

ben: PR opened: https://git.redwood.example/p/deploy-bot/pull/478 (preflight + two-owner override). staging tests passing.

ivy: PR for controller POC: https://git.redwood.example/p/flag-controller/pull/331. includes subscription and audit events.

sam: Action items and tentative due dates (epoch):
- ivy: controller POC -> 1946050000
- ben: deploy-bot preflight -> 1945790000
- noor: RFC for blast-radius & caps -> 1945710000
- infra/ops: smoke-job pipeline template -> 1945900000

sam: When you finish, react with :white_check_mark: and paste PR/ticket links here. i'll consolidate into the postmortem ticket (INC-2024-522) and schedule a 1-week follow-up to look for recurring patterns. if blockers arise, @eng-platform. :rocket:
